alt: AI-generated image of the Gallery Building at Newport on the Levee: a dark grey building with large grid windows, a white amc sign, and glass signage reading THE BEST OF everything ...AWAITS YOU and THE GALLERY, with a ring-shaped light hung over the plaza.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of a Newport on the Levee website photo (about 2023-2024) and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: about 2023-2024 (uploaded to the Newport on the Levee site January 2024)
knownDifferences: Omits the black steel pergola frame in front of the glass wall, the Brothers bar sign and all people; the PAR3 building's upper windows and the white building's window arrangement are simplified; window reflections are invented by the generator.

alt: AI-generated image of the Boone County Public Library Florence Branch: a long, low red-brick building with the words BOONE COUNTY PUBLIC LIBRARY FLORENCE BRANCH on its wall, a smaller brick entrance block with a dark recess and a blue banner, and a conifer and a purple-leaved tree in front.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the library's own photo (bcpl.org, July 2023) and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
knownDifferences: The purple-leaved tree stands in front of the long wall rather than between it and the entrance block; the entrance recess is narrower and the block's proportions are approximate.

alt: AI-generated image of the Boone County Public Library Hebron Branch: a modern single-storey building of beige stone and dark metal panels with the words BOONE COUNTY PUBLIC LIBRARY HEBRON BRANCH, a thin flat canopy, a taller dark entrance block, and a flagpole.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the library's own photo (bcpl.org, June 2023) and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
knownDifferences: Panel and window spacing under the canopy is approximate; the reference's small far-left window is omitted; the second flag hangs limp with no emblem shown.

alt: AI-generated image of the Boone County Public Library Main Library: a long red-brick and cream-stone building with a curved central bay reading BOONE COUNTY PUBLIC LIBRARY, rows of arched windows, and a domed cupola.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the library's own photo (bcpl.org, June 2023) and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
knownDifferences: Dome is a deeper plum-red than the reference's purple-grey; each wing shows five windows (the reference's right wing has four) and one oval medallion per wing is omitted; wing rooflines are simplified.

alt: AI-generated image of the Boone County Public Library Walton Branch: a single-story building with two blocks clad in vertical blue, green, yellow, grey and white stripes, joined by a glass section with a silver-grey entrance canopy.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the library's own photo on bcpl.org (2024 or earlier) and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
knownDifferences: Stripe order and widths are approximate; the reference's separate darker glass box between the centre glass and the right block is merged into one glass section; window spacing on the right block is more regular; reflections and interior lamps are generator-drawn. The right-hand block is drawn with a flat roof; in the reference its roofline slopes upward to the right.

alt: AI-generated image of the Otto M. Budig Theater at dusk: a dark metal-clad corner building with a lit glass corner window, illuminated Cincinnati Shakespeare signs, and THE OTTO M. BUDIG THEATER lettered above a lit glass lobby.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the theater's own exterior photo (cincyshakes.com, undated) and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: undated (theater's own site image, checked November 2026)
knownDifferences: Lobby interior simplified (no staircase or furnishings); street-name signs omitted; sign lettering style and glass-box pane counts are approximate; a dark corner column is shown where the reference corner is partly hidden.

alt: AI-generated image of the Falcon Theatre storefront: a lavender painted-brick building with a blue awning reading FALCON THEATRE, string lights, large windows and the street number 636.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the theatre's own building photo (about 2017) and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
knownDifferences: The left grey service door is wider than in the reference; banner is blank rather than printed; window reflections are invented by the generator.

alt: AI-generated image of the Florence Aquatic Center: a tan brick building with blue roof trim, a curved entrance tower lettered FLORENCE AQUATIC CENTER, nautical signal flags under the entry and red pennants on the roof.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the City of Florence's own photo (2021 or earlier) and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
knownDifferences: Fewer signal flags and rooftop pennants than the reference; the brick columns carry thin brown bands the reference does not show. The generator drew glass doors inside the covered entry where the reference shows an open passage with iron gates; that area is cropped out and does not appear in the final.

alt: AI-generated image of the Go Bananas Comedy Club stage: a silver Go Bananas Comedy Club sign on a violet-lit blue curtain, with a microphone stand.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of a stage photo on the club's website (August 2025) and checked against it. The performer is left out, and the stage floor is cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: August 2025 (camera date in the photo file)
knownDifferences: The performer in the reference is omitted; the part of the curtain and the final letters of the sign hidden behind the performer are filled in from the club's logo; sign letters are smoother than the reference's textured finish.

alt: AI-generated image of the Harrison Branch Library: a sloping wood-soffit entrance canopy beneath a tall glass curtain wall, between a grey block wing and a tan block wing with a band of windows, framed by feathery honey-locust branches.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the library's own exterior photo (chpl.org, undated) and checked against it. Entrances, doors, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: undated (library's own location-page photo, checked November 2026)
knownDifferences: Cropped above the entrance doors because the generator drew hinged double doors where the reference shows sliding doors; curtain-wall proportions and the small tree by the left wing are approximate; the generator's reflections are invented.

alt: AI-generated image of the playground at Lou Hartfiel Memorial Park: the top of a lime-green and purple play tower with a red dot and green star, a green tube slide, purple and lime shade canopies, and tall trees behind.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the City of Crescent Springs' own playground photo (date not stated) and checked against it. Play decks, ramps, surfacing and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: date not stated on the city page
knownDifferences: The real play structure is larger and busier: extra decks, rails, slides and a second roofed deck behind the tower are omitted. The shade canopies stand on separate poles rather than over the play decks as in the reference, and their shapes are simplified.

alt: AI-generated image of the second-floor event room at Molly Malone's Covington: green walls, two tall windows, framed pictures, wall-mounted TVs, a dark wooden back-bar with bottles, and banquet tables with white cloths.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the pub's own photo of its second-floor event room (posted 2026) and checked against it. The floor is cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: 2026 or earlier (uploaded to the pub's website June 2026)
knownDifferences: Exact table count, chair-cover pattern, framed-picture contents and the view through the windows are approximations; the room is shown from a slightly different angle; first round's invented wood wainscoting was removed.

alt: AI-generated aerial image of Riverbend Music Center: a broad grey pavilion roof with three red-brown steel lattice rigging frames behind it, and the Ohio River with a towboat and barges in front of a wooded hillside.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the venue's own aerial photo (riverbend.org, undated) and checked against it. The lawn, paths, entrances and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: undated (venue's own share image, checked November 2026)
knownDifferences: The three rigging frames are drawn identical, whereas the reference's frames differ in size; fewer boats on the river; roof chevron pattern and the right-hand hall are approximate. Round 1 was rejected because my own description misread the rigging as a roller coaster.

alt: AI-generated image of the upper facade of the Smoke Justis building: red brick with five dark windows, a green copper cornice, cream stone quoins, and a carved band reading CITIZENS TELEPHONE COMPANY INC. above diamond-pattern brick and two round windows.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of a photo on the restaurant's website (September 2020) and checked against it. Only the upper facade is shown; the street and entrances are not.
referenceDate: September 2020 (date in the photo's file name)
knownDifferences: Window sash divisions and the cornice's surface detail are approximate (the reference is small); invented stone window lintels/sills and cornice brackets from round 1 were removed; fewer utility wires than the reference.

alt: AI-generated image of the Kenton County Public Library Erlanger Branch: a red brick library with curved silver metal roofs, a glass tower with dark green frames and a round multicolored tree logo, a curved entrance canopy and wide dark-framed windows.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the library's own photo of the Erlanger Branch and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: undated summer photo (the library's own, checked November 2026)
knownDifferences: The entrance canopy is drawn as a separate curved overhang, shallower than in the reference; small lights inside the tower are generator-drawn; the tower cap and window proportions are approximate. Round 1 added stone trim around the windows, which an edit removed.

alt: AI-generated image of the William E. Durr Branch of the Kenton County Public Library in Independence: tan brick wing with raised lettering, a curved glass clerestory, and a sloped dark glass wall beside a flagpole with an American flag.
caption: AI-generated image, not a photograph. Drawn from a description of the library's own photo of the Independence (Durr) Branch and checked against it. Entrances, steps and ground level are cropped out on purpose.
referenceDate: about 2021 (the library's own photo, file named durr2021)
knownDifferences: The curved clerestory is wider and more centered than in the reference; small triangular fins along the top of the glass wall are omitted; the left wing's roofline is straight rather than gently curved. The generator drew a wider entrance with two double doors, which is cropped out.
